messages:
elaine: Heads up — we should run a 1-day OTLP+Datadog hackathon with SI partners next Thu to validate on-prem OTLP collector -> Datadog agent -> dashboard flow for Private deployments. Goal: smoke test traces + GPU metadata tagging. Who can lead?

mike: I can lead infra side. Need a checklist: collector config, firewall/egress, service mapping, GPU labels.

sam: I'll bring a sample model app and a small k8s manifest with NVIDIA GPU requests. Also a prebuilt tracing lib (opentelemetry-js) and a tiny load generator.

vijay: I'll coordinate SIs and invite 2 partners (NeonTech, AccelOps). Also pinging kevin from Datadog for dashboard support.

kevin (dd): happy to help — can provide dashboard template and agent config. Any preference for traces vs metrics priority? :thumbsup:

elaine: Traces first + GPU labels, then metrics for token throughput. Kevin do you have a small dashboard we can import and a tile for model-latency-by-gpu?

kevin (dd): I'll upload a starter JSON to the shared drive. Quick inline note: we recommend setting env tags: DD_ENV, gpu_model, gpu_uuid. I can also share a minimal dashboard export: {"dash":"gpu-inference-starter","widgets":[{"type":"timeseries","title":"model latency by gpu","query":"avg:trace.duration{service:sample-model} by {gpu_model}"}]}

sam: Quick smoke test for OTEL collector — snippet for collector.yaml:
```yaml
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      http:
      grpc:
exporters:
  datadog:
    api:
      key: ${DATADOG_API_KEY} # use agent relay for Private setups
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      exporters: [datadog]
```

mike: Network note: Private deployments often block 443 egress. Plan A: run Datadog Agent locally and point collector to it (exporter -> http://agent:8126). Plan B: use proxy relay. Add firewall checklist.

elaine: Action items:
1) Sam - provide app + manifest + small load script by Mon EOD.
2) Kevin - dashboard json + minimal agent config by Tue.
3) Mike - firewall runbook + egress smoke tests by Wed.
4) Vijay - partner invites + pre-demo checklist by Wed.
I'll create calendar invite and a short agenda.

calendar-bot: elaine created an event: "OTLP+Datadog on-prem hackathon" Thu 10:00-16:00 PT — invite sent to all.

deploy-bot: CI: sample-app build succeeded (team/smoke #542) — image ready: registry/redwood/sample-app:pr-118

sam: Local trace generator curl to hit collector (for quick manual test):
`curl -sS -X POST http://localhost:4318/v1/traces -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d @sample_trace.json`
I'll add sample_trace.json to the repo and a make target `make smoke-trace`.

vijay: NeonTech confirmed participation, AccelOps tentative (waiting on SOC clearance). Can we limit demo scope to traces + basic dashboard so partners can follow along?

mike: Agreed. We'll also add a small script to set GPU tags from node labels: `export DD_TAGS="gpu_model:$GPU_MODEL,gpu_uuid:$GPU_UUID"` — the smoke harness will populate those.

elaine: Perfect. Agenda draft: quick infra checklist (30m), deploy sample app + collector (60m), Datadog dashboard walkthrough (45m), SI pairing + run smoke tests (90m), capture blockers & next steps (15m).

kevin (dd): I'll bring a Datadog engineer for live Q&A and a prebuilt lightweight agent image (datadog/agent:lite) that works without full egress if needed.

sam: 👍 Thanks all — I'll open PR #118 with the manifest + load script and link it here when ready.

elaine: Thanks team — I'll follow up with the invite and a short repo checklist. See you Thu.
